{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm parsing worked
test_row = df.iloc[0]
print(f"Original revenue: {test_row['revenue']} -> Parsed: {test_row['revenue_numeric']}")

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders (if any)
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for any test orders (revenue == 999999.99)
test_orders = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of completed test orders (revenue == 999999.99): {test_orders.shape[0]}")

# Total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_df['revenue_numeric'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}")"}
